name: veyra-path-intellisense
description: Autocomplete file paths as you type them: imports, require, src, href, CSS url() and Markdown links. Understands tsconfig and jsconfig aliases, writes imports the way your project needs them, and warns about paths that don't exist. Free.

enumDescriptions: Follow the project: no extension for bundlers, .js for Node ESM (moduleResolution node16/nodenext)
Never add .js, .ts and similar extensions to imports
veyraPath.importExtension.description: Whether completions in imports and require() include the file extension.

veyraPath.checkPaths.description: Warn about relative and alias paths that point to files that don't exist, with a fix when there's a close match.

veyraPath.showHiddenFiles.description: Include files and folders whose names start with a dot.

veyraPath.respectFilesExclude.description: Leave out files hidden by the files.exclude setting (node_modules is always left out of relative paths' suggestions unless you type it).

veyraPath.slashAfterFolder.description: Add a / after a folder and show its contents straight away.

veyraPath.mappings.markdownDescription: Extra aliases, like `{ "@": "${workspaceFolder}/src", "~assets": "${workspaceFolder}/public/assets" }`. Aliases from tsconfig.json, jsconfig.json and package.json `imports` are found by themselves.

veyraPath.absolutePathTo.markdownDescription: The folder paths starting with `/` are relative to, like `${workspaceFolder}/public`. Empty means the workspace folder.

scripts.test:integration: tsc -p . && npm run bundle && node test/integration/run.mjs
scripts.package: npm run bundle && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/
